title: 文化祭の場面
subject_en: Flat colourful illustrations of Japanese school festival scenes with simple-faced students in uniforms, each ONE scene centred. Outlines are closed and darker than the fill; light parts (snow, paper, white fur, plates) are warm cream (#FFF6E0) or tinted, never pure white. No letters, no text, no logos.
lead: 模擬店・演劇・看板づくりなど、文化祭の準備と当日の場面を描いた12点です。ポスターや学校だより、案内に使えます。
